phone_screenshot · Capture screen

phone_open_app · Open app
Open an authorized app; the target app must also allow operations.
phone_tap · Tap
Tap a control or screen coordinate in an authorized app.
phone_swipe · Swipe
Perform a swipe gesture in an authorized app.
phone_input · Input
Write text to an editable control in an authorized app.
phone_back · Back
Send Android Back in an authorized app.
phone_unlock · Unlock
Wake and unlock the phone using separately authorized local credentials.
